detail.title: Metareasoning and Robustness in Rational Agency
detail.summary: Metareasoning-partitioning challenges require optimal resource allocation, while neuro-symbolic frameworks provide mechanisms for detecting and correcting model errors in dynamic environments. Passive error-correction models and metacognitive adaptive interventions offer potential architectures for enhancing system robustness.
detail.reason: Incorporating new evidence on neuro-symbolic rule-based frameworks and metacognitive AI into the established metareasoning inquiry.

detail.reason: Maintains active inquiry into assumption testing and epistemological self-correction.
